commit.message:
Squeeze separator spaces in one pass

`squeeze_separator_spaces` looked ahead over the rest of the whitespace run
for every whitespace character, so a run of n spaces cost O(n^2) checks.
`TIMEVALUE("4"&REPT(" ",32000)&":35")` took 4.69 s in the debug test build.

The helper now records where a whitespace run starts and decides the whole
run once, when it reaches the next non-whitespace character or the end of
the text. The output doesn't change. I compared it against the previous
version on 600,000 generated inputs and every result was identical.

Tests I ran

- `cargo test -p ironcalc_base --lib test_datevalue_timevalue_spaces` gives
  3 passed. The new long run test finishes in 0.01 s (4.69 s before).
- `cargo test -p ironcalc_base` gives 2732 passed, 8 ignored, and 23 doc
  tests passed.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` are
  clean.
